description: DO Altos de Pinto Bandeira - APP 30 m margem de drenagem is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Atualização do uso da terra em APP, obtida pela classificação supervisionada de imagens Sentinel 2 (23 de março de 2020), integrado a dados vetoriais de vinhedos mapeados pelo cadastro vitícola atualizados em janeiro de 2019. Os dados de uso da terra foram recortados pela máscara vetorial de APP com 30 m margem de drenagem. [CNPUV]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are APP 30 m de drenagem, CNPUV, Pinto Bandeira, uva e vinho, Brazil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
